data.narrative:
Orchid is a Series A biotech company led by founder Noor Siddiqui that has raised $16.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three triangulation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses total capital raised ($16.5M) as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the next funding stage, yielding an implied valuation of $33M. Peer-Median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient narrow-set comparables in the same stage and valuation tier within Biotech & Health; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met the minimum three-datapoint threshold for reliable median derivation. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Orchid's revenue figures are not on file, precluding meaningful P/S multiple application despite a 5.6x sector median across public comps.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $28M to $38M, centered on $33M. Material uncertainty remains around Orchid's actual revenue trajectory and product-market fit relative to both public and private comparables. The reliance on a single method reflects data constraints inherent to early-stage private biotech valuation.
